summary: Investigation into why the `/skill:continue` command does not appear in the Gizmo UI for the Slapdash project. The agent read skill/prompt metadata, searched source for command discovery wiring, spawned a background subagent to trace skill command history, and identified that Slapdash's `.pi/prompts/continue.md` has a `description` but no `name` field, plus Gizmo's `CommandPalette` currently only reads static `commands()` and does not yet surface dynamic/skill-based commands (per WORKLOG.md note). No fix was made.
